work_orders.title: Chiller-001 high condenser approach investigation
work_orders.description: BMS alarm for condenser approach 4.8 degC. Inspected condenser tubes — visible scale buildup. CT basin has algae. Recommended chemical treatment.
work_orders.resolution: Visual inspection confirmed fouling. Dosed CT basin with biocide. Scheduled chemical wash for next maintenance window.

work_orders.title: Chiller-001 condenser chemical wash
work_orders.description: COP dropped to 3.5. Chemical wash of condenser tubes performed with acid descaler.
work_orders.resolution: Chemical wash completed but approach temp only improved from 7.0 to 6.0 degC. Scale is calcified — chemical wash insufficient. Mechanical tube cleaning required.

work_orders.title: Chiller-001 mechanical tube cleaning + CT overhaul
work_orders.description: Chiller tripped on high pressure. Emergency mechanical tube cleaning. CT fill media replacement and full water treatment overhaul.
work_orders.resolution: Mechanical brush cleaning of 120 condenser tubes. CT fill media replaced. New water treatment programme installed. Post-repair: approach 2.5 degC, COP 5.0.
